verdict.rationale: llamafile documents a built-in HTTP server with API and Web UI options ([llamafile-docs-9], [llamafile-docs-14]), and its sandbox explicitly allows the server to accept incoming connections ([llamafile-docs-10]). However, the only documented access is http://localhost:8080 ([llamafile-docs-5]), with no evidence of binding to a network interface for other devices. Missing for 10: documented host/interface binding for LAN access, guidance on reaching the server from other devices, and hands-on corroboration of multi-device network use.
